text_blocks.snippet: Hisuian Zoroark VSTAR is a Colorless-type Pokémon VSTAR card in the Pokémon Trading Card Game, featuring 270 HP and a Fighting weakness (Fx2).
snippet_highlighted_words: Colorless-type Pokémon VSTAR card in the Pokémon Trading Card Game

list.snippet: VSTAR Power (Phantom Star): Once during your turn, you can discard your hand and draw 7 cards (you cannot use more than 1 VSTAR Power per game).
Attack (Ticking Curse): Costs [2] Energy and deals 50 damage for each of your Pokémon that has any damage counters on it (up to 300 damage max).
VSTAR Rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
Lost Origin (Base/Secret/Rainbow): Includes card numbers #147/196, #203/196 (Rainbow Rare), and #213/196.
Crown Zenith (Galarian Gallery): Features artwork under card number GG56/GG70 on TCGplayer.
Sword & Shield Promos: Released as SWSH298 via the Hisuian Zoroark VSTAR Premium Collection.

text_blocks.snippet: Most users on Reddit (r/pkmntcg) agree that the card is generally not competitively viable in modern standard formats due to self-damage trade-offs, vulnerability to single-prize attackers, and lower damage ceilings compared to contemporary alternatives.
